scope.purpose: Final disjoint tranche of the existing 20-file pinned savedata inventory: complete analysis of the nine remaining VFS memory/dispatch, scripting callback, and compile/license dependency records.

review_findings: VFileFromMemory and VFileFromConstMemory borrow caller storage; _vfmClose frees only the wrapper. VFileMemChunk uses owned anonymous memory and _vfmCloseFree releases it.

The mutable borrowed-memory backend can short-write at bufferSize; the const backend write callback returns -1. VFileMemChunk expands on writes/seeks, while truncate-without-expansion zero-fills newly visible bytes.
All memory-backend unmap calls are no-ops and sync returns true without performing I/O; this is an in-memory API contract, not durable save confirmation.

_vfmExpand does not check anonymousMemoryMap before copying, and its capacity rounding delegates size_t values to the uint32_t toPow2 helper. Allocation and representable-size limits remain material error-path obligations.
selected_files.unresolved: Trace the pinned anonymousMemoryMap implementation and all relevant limits/failure behavior; exercise memory-VFile edge cases including zero size, allocation failure, short write, and large-size arithmetic. No physical persistence claim applies.

review_findings: VFileOpen selects exactly one compile-time backend in precedence order: stdio, PSP2, 3DS, then fd; a build without any supported backend is rejected at compile time. A test built with one backend does not establish other platform dispatch behavior.
The PSP2/3DS/fd and stdio backends receive translated or original flags through different code paths; the 3DS truncate and append operations do not surface their void/seek results.
VFileReadline and the endian scalar helpers return the count reported by the backend rather than requiring a full transfer; read helpers only decode when the count is exact.
selected_files.unresolved: The caller/backend matrix across platform build configurations and the effects of backend-specific flag handling remain untested. This file does not establish which backend a downstream product selects.

selected_files.analysis_type: Behavioral source analysis; unrelated scripting/debugger portions inspected but not assessed as savedata behavior
review_findings: The mCore script wrapper exposes save/load state buffer and file functions. File methods return the mCore save/load result but ignore VFile.close's bool; saveStateBuffer maps the produced file and copies it without checking the map result.
Script load-state defaults omit SAVESTATE_SAVEDATA, while save-state defaults include SAVESTATE_ALL. These are wrapper defaults, not proof of GBA RTC or savedata serialization correctness.

mScriptContextAttachCore registers savedataUpdated using the callback macro; the macro dispatches the named event to the script context. Detach removes the callback. No persistence result is passed through this callback path.
selected_files.unresolved: Trace serialization and RTC implementation/callers, and determine downstream handling of script save/load booleans and ignored close/map outcomes. The source-extracted callback fixture does not execute this complete translation unit or a real script engine/frontend.

selected_files.analysis_type: Behavioral source analysis; callback/API documentation and registration reviewed
review_findings: The callback API adds/removes context callbacks and documents savedataUpdated as “The emulation has just finished modifying save data”; it does not define persistence success.
The standard library exports SAVESTATE_SAVEDATA and SAVESTATE_RTC flags, but these declarations alone do not define what the serializer writes or what a consumer observes after load.
selected_files.unresolved: No script execution, RTC/save-state round trip, frontend notification behavior, or persistence result is tested by this source review.

review_findings: The header supplies platform-dependent ssize_t, POSIX declarations, atomic macros, byte-order operations, and shared integer/size types used by the VFile and script paths.
Endian macros and platform compatibility branches are compile-time contracts; inspecting this header does not prove that every target configuration builds or that disk bytes are durable.
selected_files.unresolved: Pin and test the actual platform build configurations used by consumers; the header cannot settle backend-specific I/O or persistence behavior.

review_findings: MGBA_EXPORT is empty for static, non-MSVC, or standalone builds and selects dllexport/dllimport for the corresponding MSVC DLL modes; it does not alter savedata semantics.
selected_files.unresolved: Consumers' actual shared/static build configuration and exported-symbol linkage are not established by this source snapshot.

review_findings: The vector macros provide size/capacity operations; initialization/ensure-capacity use calloc/realloc without propagating allocation failures, while deinit clears storage and counters. The header is a dependency in the pinned native VFS evidence closure, not a save-file durability primitive.
selected_files.unresolved: The vector implementation's relevant consumers and allocation-failure behavior have not been tested as part of this tranche; it is not evidence that the mGBA VFile memory allocation path succeeds.

review_findings: The API declares anonymousMemoryMap(size_t) returning void* and mappedMemoryFree(void*, size_t) returning void; the interface has no explicit error result beyond a potentially null mapping.
selected_files.unresolved: The platform implementation and allocation failure/cleanup behavior are outside the remaining nine records and must be inspected before closing the VFileMem growth obligation.

review_findings: The VFileMem growth path's toPow2 helper accepts uint32_t although its caller passes size_t. Zero returns zero; values needing a 2^32 result cannot be represented by the return type and require a caller-side bound that is not established by these files.
selected_files.unresolved: Prove the caller size domain and supported address width or test boundary values; no oversized allocation behavior is approved.
